sentences.text: Yes: for a floating-rate business loan sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 to an individual or MSE, a Tier 3 UCB is barred from pre-payment charges only when the sanctioned amount or limit is up to ₹50 lakh, and this loan is ₹80 lakh.
For cases other than those covered by the no-charge rules, pre-payment charges, if any, are as per the approved policy of the UCB, and for a term loan they are based on the amount being prepaid.
The applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges must be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and any undisclosed pre-payment charges shall not be charged.
